From USSS.   “attributable to a USSS Spokesperson 

Shortly after 6:00 p.m. Saturday, an individual approached a Secret Service checkpoint in the area of 17th Street and Pennsylvania Avenue NW. A preliminary investigation indicates that as the individual approached, he removed a weapon from his bag and began firing at posted officers.

Secret Service police officers returned fire, striking the suspect, who was transported to an area hospital, where he later died. During the shooting, a bystander

From @ChadPergram   “Gunman came up on west side of WH at Gate 17 near 14th St and brandished pistol (don't know what type)
Gunman fired towards WH three times, USSS returned fire, don't know how many shots were fired but apparently took gunman down
Bystander was struck during exchange, bystander of civilian not known
Gunman did not get inside perimeter of WH”
-- from senior administration official

Statement from Kyle Busch family on what caused his death:
"The medical evaluation provided to the Busch Family concluded that severe pneumonia progressed into sepsis, resulting in rapid and overwhelming associated complications."

I don't usually pick a winner, but I am very proud of my son Paul who is officially a high school graduate-- congratulations to all 2026 graduates! #WinnersandLosers #SpecialReport

Hey Charlotte! I’ll be at the @CLTMotorSpdwy gift shop tomorrow to say hello and sign copies of The Case For America! @starr_racing will be driving the #53 Chevrolet Camaro - Joey Gase Motorsports car all decked out for the occasion. Come by and let’s cheer on all of the @NASCAR drivers for the Oreilly Series Charbroil 300 tomorrow at 5pmET! #nascar #charlottemotorspeedway
IndyCar is already looking ahead to August for the historic Freedom 250 Grabd Prix right here in Washington D.C. #indy #indy500 #america250
BREAKING: The Trump administration has issued a sweeping new directive targeting the green card application process. #trump #breakingnews #news #greencard
Energy expert Kevin Book weighs in on the UAE’s plan to expand a vital pipeline to the Gulf of Oman, bypassing the Strait of Hormuz. #specialreport #iran #oil #inflation

You can find @Walmart version of The Case For America at your local store or online on Walmart's website! Don’t forget to make your own #caseforamerica at thecaseforamerica.com (link in bio today!). #walmart #book #america250 #walmartfinds
NASCAR superstar and two-time champion Kyle Busch has died at 41 tonight.

Humanitarian crisis unfolds in the Eastern Congo. Clashes erupt as locals are blocked from retrieving a body, while overwhelmed healthcare workers issue a dire plea for staff and supplies to combat a rare Ebola outbreak. #breakingnews #news #congo

“Short term pain” is how President Trump described the economic strain Americans are feeling today due to the war in Iran in my sit down interview with him last week. Be sure to tune in tonight for more coverage on #specialreport on @Fox News 6PM ET
Longtime Democratic lawmaker and financial reform architect Barney Frank has passed away at 86.
A California doctor has been convicted by a federal jury for submitting over $45 million in fraudulent Medicare claims for cosmetic Botox injections. #news #california
Wall Street rallied as Elon Musk’s SpaceX plans a historic public listing by June 12, poised to become the first trillion-dollar U.S. market debut. #news #elonmusk #spacex
